issues.legal_issue: A tenant’s surrender of a tenancy is ineffective when the prescribed verification and recording requirements are not complied with.
material_facts: The landlord submitted a written surrender document bearing the tenant’s thumb-impression and asked the Mamlatdar to verify the surrender.
The Mamlatdar did not verify the surrender or pass a final order on the application.

A Circle Officer recorded statements from the tenant and landlord and ordered that possession be handed over to the landlord, but did not record that he was satisfied that the tenant understood the nature and consequences of surrender and acted voluntarily.
The Circle Officer did not endorse the required findings on the surrender document.
The Deputy Collector and Revenue Tribunal found that the surrender had not been verified as required; the High Court upheld the conclusion that the surrender was invalid.
issues.conclusion: The surrender was invalid and ineffective because the mandatory verification and endorsement requirements had not been met; the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5(3)(b) of the Bombay Tenancy Act and Rule 2-A require a surrender to be in writing, verified by the Mamlatdar after satisfying himself that the tenant understands its nature and consequences and that it is voluntary, and endorsed with those findings on the surrender document. These requirements are mandatory in light of their peremptory language and protective purpose. Where the law prescribes a manner for exercising a power, it must be exercised in that manner or not at all. The Court relied on Liverpool Borough Bank v. Turner and Craies on Statute Law on determining whether a provision is mandatory, and Taylor v. Taylor, Nazir Ahmed v. Emperor, Shiv Bahadur Singh v. State of U.P., and Deep Chand v. State of Rajasthan on the prescribed-manner rule.

rule.if: tenancy_surrender_proceeding and surrender_attempted and (not required_verification_completed or not required_finding_endorsed)

predicates.tenancy_surrender_proceeding: The matter concerns a tenant’s surrender of a tenancy to a landlord.
predicates.surrender_attempted: The tenant purported to surrender the tenancy.
predicates.required_verification_completed: An authorized officer verified the surrender after determining that the tenant understood its nature and consequences and acted voluntarily.
predicates.required_finding_endorsed: The authorized officer recorded the required findings on the surrender document.

issues.definition: When a tenant attempts to surrender a tenancy, the surrender is invalid if the prescribed verification was not completed or the required findings were not recorded on the surrender document.
